BundledFile.description: A file shipped beside the instructions.

path.description: Relative to the skill directory, with forward slashes on every platform.

text.description:
`None` for anything that is not UTF-8 text, or above [`MAX_TEXT_FILE_BYTES`]: an image
is a file to count, not to read.

PluginInput.description: What a plugin is sent, and what it answers with.

version.description: The wire format's version, so a plugin can refuse a shape it does not know.

PluginInput.title: PluginInput

Reference.description:
Where a rule's claim comes from.

Not optional, and that is the point: every rule here asserts something about someone else's
writing, and an assertion with no source has to be taken on trust. A rule without a citation
does not get into the registry.

body_offset.description: Byte offset of the body inside `source`.

directory.description: The directory, as it was given on the command line.

document.description: `SKILL.md`, relative to the run, for reporting.

frontmatter_lines.description: Everything before the body, so a line in the body can be turned into a line in the file.

has_frontmatter.description: Whether a frontmatter block was found at all.

metadata.description: Frontmatter keys other than name and description, in the order they were written.

name_declared.description:
Whether the frontmatter declared `name:` at all. The directory-name fallback in
[`read`] is display text for messages, not a declaration, and the name rules must not
mistake one for the other.

notes.description: What could not be read, said out loud rather than dropped.

scalar_types.description:
The YAML type each top-level frontmatter key parsed as, so a rule can tell a
`description: true` was not written as a string.

source.description: The whole file, frontmatter included. Fixes are byte offsets into this.

description: The wire contract between slint and a WebAssembly plugin: one JSON document in (PluginInput), one JSON document out (PluginOutput), one exported `lint` function. See https://slint.dev/plugin-abi for what each field means and what a failure costs.
title: slint plugin ABI
